definitions.claims_recorded: claims per node in the last row of the run's history. The row is written after the round's flows and before that round's asset step, and held units are not in it, so on a carrier with an asset layer it is not the state the run ends in. Every top-level field of this record, and its criteria, are read on this account.
definitions.claims_settled: claims per node after the last round's asset step: rent, stretch-debt service, resale settlement. The claims the run ends with. Present only when the carrier has an asset layer; on the plain carrier the recorded row is already the end state, and the record counts the runs in which it is.
definitions.net_worth: claims_settled plus held units at each tier's closing price. The account revaluation is on. Present only with an asset layer.
